messages:
maria (partnerships): FYI — CipherLock reached out with a consolidated ask: SSO/SAML + SCIM, integrate their HSM-backed secrets store with our private deployment, and get a marketplace listing ready for a joint announcement. They want a launch window in ~6 weeks.
raj (eng): 6 weeks is tight for an HSM connector + E2E tests. Do we have an internal KMS compatibility spec ready?
anna (security): We have the KMS compatibility checklist (auth, key lifecycle, attestation). @raj I'll drop the checklist link in a sec. We also need to confirm CipherLock's attestation process (they mentioned TPM + remote attestation).
luis (pm): Priorities: 1) SSO/SCIM for customer onboarding, 2) secrets connector for Redwood Private, 3) marketplace listing + joint PR. If we can stagger: SSO/SCIM first (2 wks), HSM connector next (4–6 wks). Thoughts?
olivia (marketing): If we can commit to a firm SSO/SCIM date, we can prepare a soft co-marketing plan and one-pager. Need partner logo/brand guidelines by EOD next Wednesday.
jessica (legal): We'll need a joint announcement review cycle + partner approvals for logos/case studies. Also confirm any usage of partner trademarks in marketplace copy. I can prep a short checklist.
maria (partnerships): CipherLock sent their integration deck and SAML metadata. They said SCIM supports groups and provisioning, and their HSM exposes PKCS#11 endpoints for on-prem. I'll upload the deck to the thread.
raj (eng): Key technical concerns: - PKCS#11 compatibility with our containerized runtime - Network reachability for customer-deployed HSMs (we support VPC peering but need a playbook) - Fallback to software keystore for hosted/Dedicated.
anna (security): Also require HSM attestation + proof-of-ownership flow before we allow autosync of secrets. We should lock down the default TTL and rotation policy for partner-managed keys.
luis (pm): Action items I'm taking: 1) Draft timeline (w/ milestones) by EOD tomorrow. 2) Coordinate test matrix with @raj and @anna. 3) Work w/ @olivia on marketing assets.
olivia (marketing): Great. For press: do we want a joint blog + marketplace spotlight? If yes, need partner quote and 2 customer use-cases (can be anonymized).
maria (partnerships): CipherLock offered an engineering contact (sam.cipherlock) for API level questions and a PM (harper). They asked for a technical kick-off next Tue. Can we make Tues 10am PT?
raj (eng): I'm out Tue morning but can join 11am PT. Prefer an async pre-read: send architecture diagram + sample PKCS#11 config.
maria (partnerships): will do. Pre-read will include: - high-level flow for key usage in Redwood Private - sample PKCS#11 config - expected failure modes (latency, auth errors)
anna (security): Please include expected attestation headers and signing cert thumbprints in pre-read. We need to run a mock attestation in staging.
jessica (legal): Also request their SOC2 / ISO docs and any third-party pen-test summary. We'll need to track contract addendum for key custody.
deploy-bot: reminder: partnership-kickoff-2026-03-30 created and added to calendar.
luis (pm): Quick ask to the engs: can we scope a minimal viable connector that supports: - wrap/unwrap via PKCS#11 - key metadata mapping - fallthrough to software keystore? If yes, we'll call that MVP and ship SSO/SCIM + MVP HSM in wave 1.
raj (eng): Yes we can scope that. Will need 2 engineers full-time for 3 weeks + test infra. I'll propose names in timeline doc.
olivia (marketing): Noted. If MVP HSM is on our side, marketing will position it as "HSM-ready secrets integration" and clarify hosted vs private capabilities. Need legal to sign off on wording.
maria (partnerships): Next steps: 1) I will confirm Tue 11am PT kickoff with CipherLock. 2) @luis to share timeline doc. 3) @raj/@anna to review pre-read and list infra blockers. 4) @jessica to list legal docs needed. We'll reconvene in this thread after kickoff. :thumbsup:
raj (eng): ACK. I'll start a repo scaffold and add CI tests for PKCS#11 emulator.
anna (security): ACK — will prepare the attestation test harness and rotation policy template.
jessica (legal): ACK — will send the document checklist and a contract addendum template by EOD Friday.
olivia (marketing): I'll draft a short partner co-marketing checklist and share tomorrow.
maria (partnerships): Thanks team — will share CipherLock pre-read shortly.
